title: Yellow Yellowstone Italian Sherry Paccheri Pasta
description: A rich, umami-packed Italian dish featuring aerated sherry and Paccheri pasta, served in a hot stone bowl.

ingredients.name: Sherry (dry, such as Fino or Amontillado)

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the Paccheri pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a separate pan, sauté the sliced mushrooms and chopped onion in butter until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Pour in the sherry and cook until the liquid is reduced by half, scraping up any browned bits from the pan.
Add the cooked Paccheri pasta to the pan, tossing to combine with the mushroom and sherry mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a hot stone bowl and top with grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
